baseline.text: I eye the dark slab without moving from my post. “I remember a traveler brought a shining stone that carried voices, but this one is quiet now. Tell me what you claim it does—before you make trouble.”

baseline.text: I draw my gaze close, not my hand—my fingers hover near the hilt, but I do not strike. “So it answers when shown?” I say, voice measured. I step half a pace nearer, watching the slab’s glow as one would watch a small lamp through glass, and I ask, “What does your friend say it is—stone, metal, or something living?”
